item.title: Mortal Kombat's creator wants your opinion — what would be the best way for Xbox to bring back Killer Instinct?
item.description: How would you revive Xbox's Killer Instinct fighting game franchise? Ed Boon, the creator of Mortal Kombat, wants to hear your opinion on the matter.

item.title: Microsoft just released an actually good Windows 11 update — with system performance improvements, better wake from sleep, and more
item.description: The Windows 11 non-security feature preview update for February just landed, and it's the first Windows update in a long while that includes a number of actually good changes. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Discord delays its global age verification update after widespread backlash, severing Persona ties — "We’re listening. We'll get this right"
item.description: After weeks of intense backlash, Discord has announced it's delaying the rollout of its global age verification requirements until later in 2026.

item.title: This Razer Xbox headset stomps out the competition in terms of sound and comfort quality — for just $100, you'll never get ambushed in Overwatch again
item.description: We have discovered a monumental 50% discount for the Razer BlackShark V2 Pro for Xbox, a gaming headset from 2024 that holds today for its superb audio quality, comfortable design, and all-day battery life.

item.title: Windows 11 keeps adding new features — but two of them feel like classic “Microsoft, please stop” moments
item.description: Windows 11 Snap Assist and Drag Tray flyouts can disrupt multitasking. Here’s why they feel unnecessary and how to disable them on your computer.

item.title: Microsoft's new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma celebrates Phil Spencer's legacy — "A lot of careers get summed up by milestones. Phil’s impact shows up in stories."
item.description: With Microsoft Gaming CEO and Xbox head Phil Spencer retiring and Asha Sharma taking his place, she took to social media to celebrate Spencer's legacy.

item.title: Exclusive: Talking to new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and CCO Matt Booty — "This team has brought it back before, and I'm here to help us do it again."
item.description: As former Xbox CEO Phil Spencer prepares to exit, we caught up with incoming CEO Asha Sharma and newly promoted CCO Matt Booty to learn about what the future holds for Microsoft's gaming operation.

item.title: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma explains “return to Xbox,” stating “Xbox starts with console” in our interview
item.description: In an exclusive interview, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reassures fans that console remains the foundation of Xbox’s future strategy and hardware investment.

item.title: From our conversations with Xbox leadership: a firm stand against AI‑generated junk — "we're committed to art made by people"
item.description: In another haymaker against the use of AI, Asha Sharma and Matt Booty sat down with Windows Central to discuss its use.
